newsitem.title: USA: Fibreboard intends to acquire Fabwel for $120 million.
newsitem.headline: Fibreboard intends to acquire Fabwel for $120 million.

text.p: Fibreboard Corp. said Tuesday it intends to acquire privately held Fabwel Inc. for $120 million.

Fabwel, based in Elkhart, Ind., is a maker of exterior components such as aluminum sheets for the housing, recreational vehicle, building and construction, and transportation/cargo industries. It has annual revenues of $200 million.
The company employs more than 700 people in eight plants in Indiana, Georgia; Florida and Texas.
Recently, Fabwel expanded into the production of vinyl siding with a new facility in Atlanta, Ga.
The acquisition is expected to be completed in the second quarter of this year.
Following the news, Fibreboard's stock jumped $1.25 to $34.375 in early trading on the American Stock Exchange.
